THIRD-PARTY SOFTWARE NOTICES AND INFORMATION

CodeBrix.Graphics3D.Gltf2 is a library for reading, writing and building
Khronos glTF 2.0 3D models (.gltf and .glb) in .NET. It is a port and
adaptation of the SharpGLTF project; the source code of this repository's
library and test projects is derived from SharpGLTF and carries the notice
reproduced in section 1.

The test project additionally carries a small set of 3D model and image files
used as test inputs. Every one of them comes from a source whose license is
identified in section 3 (or was written for this repository); none of them is
part of the CodeBrix.Graphics3D.Gltf2 assembly or NuGet package.

Jeremy Ellis and contributors license the CodeBrix.Graphics3D.Gltf2 project to
you under the terms set forth in the LICENSE file, which is located at the root
of this repository. The third-party material listed below remains under its own
license, as stated for each item.

If you have any questions about any third-party code or assets referenced here,
or if you believe that any third-party material has been included in
CodeBrix.Graphics3D.Gltf2 in error, please open a new issue at:
https://github.com/ellisnet/CodeBrix.Graphics3D.Gltf2/issues

================================================================================
1. SharpGLTF
================================================================================

Project:      SharpGLTF
Source:       https://github.com/vpenades/SharpGLTF
Baseline:     tag v1.0.7, commit acbc151e70d65ceb8bec24fa95f0067d0e5ed933 --
              the source of the SharpGLTF.Core, SharpGLTF.Runtime and
              SharpGLTF.Toolkit 1.0.7 NuGet packages
Copyright:    Copyright (c) 2019 Vicente Penades
              (and the SharpGLTF contributors; see the upstream repository's
              history for the full list)
License:      MIT (full text below)

Scope of the port
-----------------

CodeBrix.Graphics3D.Gltf2 incorporates the source code of the three upstream
projects behind the SharpGLTF.Core, SharpGLTF.Runtime and SharpGLTF.Toolkit
NuGet packages, plus the two shared source files each of them links in, merged
into ONE assembly:

  * src/SharpGLTF.Core      -> src/CodeBrix.Graphics3D.Gltf2/
                               (glTF 2.0 document model, IO, memory accessors,
                               transforms, animations, validation, reflection)
  * src/SharpGLTF.Runtime   -> src/CodeBrix.Graphics3D.Gltf2/Runtime/
                               (scene templates and instances, mesh decoding)
  * src/SharpGLTF.Toolkit   -> src/CodeBrix.Graphics3D.Gltf2/
                               (mesh, material and scene builders, vertex
                               types, Schema2 conversion helpers)
  * src/Shared/Guard.cs, src/Shared/_Extensions.cs
                            -> src/CodeBrix.Graphics3D.Gltf2/ (root)

The upstream test suites for those projects are likewise incorporated, ported
from NUnit to xUnit.v3 + SilverAssertions, into ONE test project:

  * tests/SharpGLTF.Core.Tests       -> tests/CodeBrix.Graphics3D.Gltf2.Tests/
  * tests/SharpGLTF.Runtime.Tests    -> tests/CodeBrix.Graphics3D.Gltf2.Tests/Runtime/
  * tests/SharpGLTF.Toolkit.Tests    -> tests/CodeBrix.Graphics3D.Gltf2.Tests/
  * tests/SharpGLTF.ThirdParty.Tests -> tests/CodeBrix.Graphics3D.Gltf2.Tests/ThirdParty/
  * tests/SharpGLTF.NUnit            -> tests/CodeBrix.Graphics3D.Gltf2.Tests/TestSupport/
                                        (test helpers only)

Three small test input files come from the upstream repository's tests/Assets
folder and are covered by the same MIT license:

  * tests/CodeBrix.Graphics3D.Gltf2.Tests/Assets/Invalid_Json.gltf
  * tests/CodeBrix.Graphics3D.Gltf2.Tests/Assets/white space.gltf
  * tests/CodeBrix.Graphics3D.Gltf2.Tests/Assets/SpecialCases/RelativePaths.gltf

tests/CodeBrix.Graphics3D.Gltf2.Tests/Assets/API/API.SharpGLTF.1.0.7.txt is a
listing of the public API of the SharpGLTF.Core, SharpGLTF.Runtime and
SharpGLTF.Toolkit 1.0.7 assemblies (namespace renamed), used by a test that
checks this library still exposes every one of those signatures.

Not incorporated: the upstream SharpGLTF.Ext.3DTiles and SharpGLTF.Ext.Agi
extension libraries, the SharpGLTF.CodeGen code generators and the build/
tools, the examples/ projects, the Toolkit's T4 text templates (their generated
.cs output IS incorporated), the AOT and DownloadTestFiles test projects, the
tests that need externally downloaded model collections, and the upstream test
assets whose origin or license could not be identified.

Modifications made during the port
----------------------------------

  * Namespaces renamed: SharpGLTF[.Sub] -> CodeBrix.Graphics3D.Gltf2[.Sub].
    Every ported file records its origin with a
    `//was previously: <upstream-namespace>;` comment on its namespace line.
  * The three upstream assemblies were merged into a single assembly and a
    single NuGet package. One file-name collision was resolved by renaming the
    Toolkit's Diagnostics/DebugViews.cs to Diagnostics/DebugViews.Toolkit.cs.
  * Retargeted from the upstream multi-targeting (netstandard2.0,
    netstandard2.1, net6.0, net8.0, net10.0) to net10.0 only. Conditional-
    compilation branches that cannot execute on .NET 10 were removed along
    with their `#if` / `#elif` / `#else` / `#endif` directives; the branch that
    .NET 10 compiles was kept. `#if DEBUG` and the upstream developer toggle
    `SUPRESSTRYCATCH` were kept as-is.
  * Block-scoped namespaces converted to file-scoped namespaces; `using`
    directives that upstream placed inside a namespace block were hoisted above
    it and fully qualified.
  * The glTF `asset.generator` value written into saved models changed from
    "SharpGLTF <version>" to "CodeBrix.Graphics3D.Gltf2 <version>".
  * ReadContext.CreateFromDirectory normalises '\' to '/' in relative URIs, so
    models written with Windows path separators load on Linux and macOS too.
  * StyleCop `#pragma` lines removed (the build does not run StyleCop); a few
    malformed XML documentation references and missing <param> tags fixed; the
    three reflection-based diagnostic helpers annotated for trimming analysis.
  * Strong-name signing dropped.
  * Tests: NUnit replaced with xUnit.v3 + SilverAssertions; TestAttachments,
    Plotly.Sharp, Newtonsoft.Json and SixLabors.ImageSharp usage replaced
    (attachments are plain files, plots are CSV files, JSON uses
    System.Text.Json, the one generated PNG uses CodeBrix.Imaging); tests that
    depended on removed or unidentified assets were retargeted to the assets in
    section 3 or dropped.

Code incorporated in SharpGLTF from the .NET runtime
----------------------------------------------------

src/CodeBrix.Graphics3D.Gltf2/Transforms/Matrix4x4Double.cs is, per its
upstream comment, stripped from System.Numerics.Matrix4x4 in the .NET runtime
(https://github.com/dotnet/runtime), which is licensed under the MIT License:

    Copyright (c) .NET Foundation and Contributors

    (the MIT License text below applies, with this copyright line)

================================================================================
2. Test assets written for this repository
================================================================================

These test inputs were written for CodeBrix.Graphics3D.Gltf2 and are covered by
its LICENSE:

  * Assets/cube-integer-min-max-bounds.gltf, Assets/XmpJsonLd.gltf and
    Assets/SpecialCases/Invalid_EmptyArray.gltf (hand-authored glTF
    documents that reproduce specific loader cases)
  * Assets/white space.jpg, Assets/SpecialCases/RelativePaths.jpg and
    Assets/SpecialCases/Textures/Texture1.jpg (2x2 placeholder images)

(Paths are relative to tests/CodeBrix.Graphics3D.Gltf2.Tests/.)

================================================================================
3. Third-party test assets
================================================================================

The files below are test inputs only. They are copied unmodified from their
sources unless a note says otherwise, and they are not part of the
CodeBrix.Graphics3D.Gltf2 assembly or NuGet package. Paths are relative to
tests/CodeBrix.Graphics3D.Gltf2.Tests/Assets/.

3.1 Khronos glTF Sample Assets
------------------------------

Source:    https://github.com/KhronosGroup/glTF-Sample-Assets
Baseline:  commit c6a6bd13ab2b3c685c7903d03561b8a9392f38b8
Location:  KhronosSampleAssets/Models/<Model>/ -- each model's folder keeps its
           upstream LICENSE.md and metadata.json, which are the authoritative
           statement of that model's license.

Only the variants the tests use are included. Per model (title, credit, year,
license):

  * AnimatedMorphCube (glTF-Binary, glTF-Quantized)
      "Animated Morph Cube" -- Microsoft, 2017 -- CC0-1.0
  * AnimationPointerUVs (glTF-Binary)
      "AnimationPointerUVs" -- 3D asset and textures by Eric Chadwick, 2024
      -- CC-BY-4.0
  * BoxAnimated (glTF-Binary)
      "Box Animated" -- Cesium, 2017 -- CC-BY-4.0
  * BoxTextured (glTF)
      "Box Textured" -- Cesium, 2017 -- CC-BY-4.0; the Cesium logo texture is
      a non-copyrightable logo and trademark of Cesium
      (LicenseRef-LegalMark-Cesium)
  * CesiumMan (glTF-Binary)
      "Cesium Man" -- Cesium, 2017 -- CC-BY-4.0; contains the Cesium logo
      (LicenseRef-LegalMark-Cesium)
  * CubeVisibility (glTF-Binary)
      "CubeVisibility" -- Aaron Franke, 2025 -- CC0-1.0
  * FlightHelmet (one texture only:
    glTF-KTX-BasisU/FlightHelmet_Materials_LensesMat_Normal.ktx2)
      "Flight Helmet" -- conversion from Maya by Gary Hsu, 2018 -- CC0-1.0
  * Fox (glTF-Binary)
      "Fox" -- model by PixelMannen, 2014, CC0-1.0; rigging and animation by
      tomkranis, 2014, CC-BY-4.0; conversion to glTF by @AsoboStudio and
      @scurest, 2017, CC-BY-4.0
  * IridescenceMetallicSpheres (glTF)
      "Iridescence Metallic Spheres" -- UX3D, 2022 -- CC0-1.0
  * MorphPrimitivesTest (glTF-Binary)
      "Morph-Primitives Test" -- ft-lab, 2018 -- CC-BY-4.0
  * NormalTangentMirrorTest (glTF-Binary)
      "Normal-Tangent Mirror Test" -- Ed Mackey, 2018 -- CC-BY-4.0
  * NormalTangentTest (glTF-Binary)
      "Normal-Tangent Test" -- Ed Mackey, 2018 -- CC0-1.0
  * OrientationTest (glTF-Binary)
      "Orientation Test" -- Khronos, 2017 -- CC-BY-4.0
  * RiggedFigure (glTF-Binary)
      "Rigged Figure" -- Cesium, 2017 -- CC-BY-4.0
  * RiggedSimple (glTF-Binary)
      "Rigged Simple" -- Cesium, 2017 -- CC-BY-4.0
  * SimpleSparseAccessor (glTF)
      "Simple Sparse Accessor" -- Marco Hutter (https://github.com/javagl/),
      2017 -- CC-BY-4.0
  * Suzanne (glTF)
      "Suzanne" -- Norbert Nopper, 2017 -- CC0-1.0
  * TextureTransformMultiTest (glTF-Binary)
      "Texture Transform Multi Test" -- Ed Mackey, 2020 -- CC-BY-4.0
  * TextureTransformTest (glTF)
      "Texture Transform Test" -- Microsoft, 2018 -- CC0-1.0
  * UnlitTest (glTF-Binary)
      "Unlit Test" -- Ed Mackey, 2019 -- CC-BY-4.0

The LICENSE.md and metadata.json documentation files are themselves licensed
CC-BY-4.0 by The Khronos Group Inc.
